preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 1000 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the array N is between 3 and 1000.
The sum of all N values across all test cases does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[i]) == Ns[i] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output contains exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output[i][j]) <= 10**18 for i in range(T) for j in range(Ns[i]))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output array is between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.expression: all(any(gcd(subseq) == i for subseq in subsequences(output[i], k)) for i in range(T) for k in range(2, Ns[i]+1) for i in range(1, Ns[i]+1))
postconditions.description: For each test case and each i from 1 to N, there exists a subsequence of length at least 2 such that the GCD of the subsequence is i.
